processDefinition.name: tenant-a-etl-pipeline
processDefinition.description: S3 raw upload → EMR Serverless ETL → Deequ Quality Check → Redshift COPY → Validate → Glue Crawler

taskDefinitionList.name: check-s3-raw-data
taskDefinitionList.description: Verify raw data exists in S3 before triggering ETL

taskParams.rawScript: aws s3 ls s3://${S3_BUCKET}/raw/tenant-a/ | grep -q . || { echo 'No raw data found'; exit 1; }

taskDefinitionList.name: emr-serverless-spark-etl
taskDefinitionList.description: Run Spark ETL on EMR Serverless — clean and transform raw CSV to Parquet

taskDefinitionList.name: deequ-quality-check
taskDefinitionList.description: Run PyDeequ quality gate — blocks Redshift load if checks fail

taskDefinitionList.name: redshift-copy
taskDefinitionList.description: COPY processed Parquet from S3 into Redshift via the Redshift Data API (IAM-authenticated, no plaintext credentials)

taskParams.rawScript:
import boto3, os, time

client = boto3.client('redshift-data', region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1'))
bucket   = os.environ['S3_BUCKET']
role_arn = os.environ['REDSHIFT_COPY_ROLE_ARN']
cluster_id = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_CLUSTER_ID', 'ds-aws-redshift')
database   = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_DATABASE', 'analytics')
db_user    = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_DB_USER', 'dsadmin')

sql = f"COPY tenant_a_events FROM 's3://{bucket}/processed/tenant-a/' IAM_ROLE '{role_arn}' FORMAT AS PARQUET;"

resp = client.execute_statement(
    ClusterIdentifier=cluster_id,
    Database=database,
    DbUser=db_user,
    Sql=sql,
)
stmt_id = resp['Id']
print(f'Submitted statement: {stmt_id}')

while True:
    desc = client.describe_statement(Id=stmt_id)
    status = desc['Status']
    print(f'Status: {status}')
    if status == 'FINISHED':
        print(f"Rows loaded: {desc.get('ResultRows', 'n/a')}")
        break
    if status in ('FAILED', 'ABORTED'):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Redshift COPY failed: {desc.get('Error', status)}")
    time.sleep(5)

taskDefinitionList.name: validate-row-count
taskDefinitionList.description: Alert (non-blocking) if loaded row count deviates > 20% from yesterday

taskParams.rawScript:
import boto3, os, time

client = boto3.client('redshift-data', region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1'))
cluster_id = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_CLUSTER_ID', 'ds-aws-redshift')
database   = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_DATABASE', 'analytics')
db_user    = os.environ.get('REDSHIFT_DB_USER', 'dsadmin')

sql = (
    "SELECT today_count, yesterday_count, "
    "CASE WHEN yesterday_count > 0 AND ABS(today_count::FLOAT - yesterday_count) / yesterday_count > 0.2 "
    "THEN 'WARNING: row count delta > 20%' ELSE 'OK' END AS validation_status "
    "FROM (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 END) AS today_count, "
    "COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE - 1 THEN 1 END) AS yesterday_count "
    "FROM tenant_a_events) t"
)

resp = client.execute_statement(
    ClusterIdentifier=cluster_id,
    Database=database,
    DbUser=db_user,
    Sql=sql,
)
stmt_id = resp['Id']
print(f'Submitted statement: {stmt_id}')

while True:
    desc = client.describe_statement(Id=stmt_id)
    status = desc['Status']
    if status == 'FINISHED':
        result = client.get_statement_result(Id=stmt_id)
        for record in result['Records']:
            print(f'today={record[0]} yesterday={record[1]} status={record[2]}')
        break
    if status in ('FAILED', 'ABORTED'):
        # Non-blocking per task description — log and move on, don't fail the DAG.
        print(f"Row count validation query did not complete: {desc.get('Error', status)}")
        break
    time.sleep(5)

taskDefinitionList.name: glue-crawler-update-catalog
taskDefinitionList.description: Trigger Glue Crawler to refresh Data Catalog schema after successful load

taskParams.rawScript:
import boto3, os, time

crawler_name = os.environ['GLUE_CRAWLER_NAME']
client = boto3.client('glue')

# Wait if crawler is already running
for _ in range(6):
    state = client.get_crawler(Name=crawler_name)['Crawler']['State']
    if state == 'READY':
        break
    print(f'Crawler state: {state}, waiting...')
    time.sleep(10)

client.start_crawler(Name=crawler_name)
print(f'Started crawler: {crawler_name}')

# Wait for completion (async — max 5 min wait)
for _ in range(30):
    state = client.get_crawler(Name=crawler_name)['Crawler']['State']
    print(f'Crawler state: {state}')
    if state == 'READY':
        last_crawl = client.get_crawler(Name=crawler_name)['Crawler'].get('LastCrawl', {})
        status = last_crawl.get('Status', 'UNKNOWN')
        print(f'Last crawl status: {status}')
        if status == 'FAILED':
            raise RuntimeError(f'Glue Crawler failed: {last_crawl.get("ErrorMessage", "")}')
        break
    time.sleep(10)
